requirements.text: When a relevant target is approached with a time to collision of 2.8 s or less at an ego speed between 10 km/h and 150 km/h, the AebController shall issue a forward collision warning.
When the forward collision warning has been active for at least 0.8 s and the time to collision is 1.8 s or less, the AebController shall request partial braking of 4 m/s2.
When the time to collision is 1.2 s or less during a warning or partial braking, the AebController shall request full braking of 8 m/s2.
When during a warning without braking the time to collision rises above 3.3 s or the target is no longer relevant, the AebController shall end the warning.
While braking, the AebController shall continue braking until the ego vehicle no longer approaches the target or has stopped.
When the driver presses the accelerator pedal to 80 % or more during a warning or braking, the AebController shall cancel the intervention.
When the driver presses the brake pedal during braking, the AebController shall continue braking.
The AebController shall treat a radar object as relevant only if it is valid, at most 150 m ahead, at most 1.8 m from the ego lane centre and approaching at more than 0.5 m/s.
If the ego speed is below 10 km/h or above 150 km/h, then the AebController shall not start a warning.
If the ego vehicle approaches a stationary vehicle in its lane at 20 km/h to 60 km/h without driver reaction, then the AebController shall avoid the collision.
If the ego vehicle approaches a stationary vehicle in its lane at 80 km/h without driver reaction, then the AebController shall reduce the impact speed to 40 km/h or less.
If the ego vehicle approaches a vehicle driving at 20 km/h in its lane at up to 80 km/h without driver reaction, then the AebController shall avoid the collision.

If no valid RadarObject frame is received for 120 ms, or no valid EgoState or DriverInput frame for 60 ms, then the AebController shall enter FAULT, request no braking and issue no warning, until all inputs are valid again.
The AebController shall send the AebCommand message every 20 ms with E2E protection and report its state, the warning and the requested deceleration in it.

tests.name: S01_ApproachToAStationaryVehicleRunsThroughTheWholeCascade
tests.scenario: Approach to a stationary vehicle runs through the whole cascade

steps.text: Given the ego vehicle drives at 50 km/h
And a stationary vehicle stands 60 m ahead
When 8 s pass
Then a forward collision warning was issued at a time to collision between 2.7 s and 2.9 s
And the warning preceded braking by at least 0.8 s
And emergency braking started at a time to collision between 1.7 s and 1.9 s
And emergency braking started with 4 m/s2
And full braking started at a time to collision between 1.1 s and 1.3 s
And the requested deceleration reached 8 m/s2
And no collision occurred
And the ego vehicle has stopped
And the AEB state is STANDBY
And every command frame passed the E2E check
And one command frame was sent per 20 ms
